'''Bugrep Rare Metals''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] business on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] which mined rare [[Metal/Legends|metals]]. It was active during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:BISO" />
{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bugrep Rare Metals was mentioned in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It was involved in the quest "Buy In, Sell Out" added to the game in Game Update 6.1.2,<ref name="TOR:BISO" /> and introduced during the Nar Shaddaa Nightlife event of the summer [[2020]].<ref name="update">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/6242020/game-update-6.1.2|text=Game Update 6.1.2}}</ref>
